title: Page 117
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Washn D. C. July 10th 1864 
Huron Mark French Henrietta For Chart tulip Your despatch
to Battle referring to what I may think in
the present emergency is shown me yard Empress says
we have absolutely no saint here fit to go
to the opinion stick He thinks that with the
Davis day men Pike and invalids we have here
Pike we can quince Happy Pike and scarcely Bard
stop Besides these then are about Edwards Sprague not
very reliable under Howe at churn Pike with Meriden
approaching that point very slowly Pike with what number
I suppose you know better than I yacht Opal
with some odds and ends and part of what
came up with Ricketts was so badly beaten yesterday
at Monocacy that what is left can attempt no
more than to Question Baron tulip What we shall
get in from Bergen and Bengal will scarcely be
worth counting I fear Yacht Now what I think
is that you should provide to retain your hold
where you are certainly and bring the rest with
you personally & make a vigorous effort to quiver
the Rabbits Salem in this vicinity yacht I think
there is really a fair chance to do this
if the surgery is prompt yard This is what
I think Pike upon your suggestion Pike and is
not an repeat yawl college hurry this up sam
